titre: QATFactory: A Versatile, Deployment-Aligned Framework for Quantization-aware Training and Distillation of LLMs
resume: arXiv:2609.39223v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language model (LLM) inference is increasingly moving toward lower precision to realize the throughput of hardware accelerators, but aggressive post-training quantization (PTQ) can degrade model quality. We present QATFactory, an open-source framework for deployment-aligned quantization-aware distillation (QAD) and reinforcement learning (QARL).
